about: The graduale of the formulary “Most Precious Blood of Our Lord Jesus Christ” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: This is He who came through water and blood, Jesus Christ: not in water only, but in water and blood. There are three who give testimony in heaven: the Father, the Word, and the Holy Spirit; and these three are one. And there are three who give testimony on earth: the Spirit, the water, and the blood; and these three are one.
